notes.title: Dwarf Delve - "How It's Done" Trailer
notes.content:
Hey Delvelings!

Chief Dwarf here with some (actual) news!

Take a gander at this here, [b]BRAND NEW[/b], trailer! 

Our [b]Number 1[/b] employee, Jordy, will show you the ropes so that you can get up to speed and bringing in those [strike]profits[/strike] construction materials in no time!

[previewyoutube=-7Ln41ULxAw;full][/previewyoutube]

See you soon and keep minin'! 

[i][b]- Chief Dwarf (Gloom Box)[/b][/i]
